title: Repurposing FDA-Approved Drugs as Fructosamine-3-Kinase Inhibitors: A Mechanistic and Translational Approach to Redox-Driven Cancer Therapy.
authors: Alves, Erica; Bannimath, Gurupadayya; Prabhakaran, Prabitha
one_liner_zh: 该文综述FN3K酶在癌症氧化还原中的作用及FDA药物重定位，虽涉及Nrf2转录因子但核心是酶-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K), a deglycating enzyme originally studied in the context of diabetes, has recently emerged as a pivotal modulator of redox homeostasis and therapeutic resistance in cancer. FN3K catalyzes the removal of early glycation adducts, thereby stabilizing redox-sensitive proteins such as Nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), a key transcriptional regulator of antioxidant defense. This review explores the evolving role of FN3K in tumor metabolism, highlighting its expression patterns across cancer types, structural features amenable to therapeutic targeting, and mechanistic interplay with the Nrf2 pathway. Emphasis is placed on FDA-approved drugs with FN3K-modulatory potential, evaluated through computational modeling, docking simulations, and structure - activity insights. The analysis reveals a dual opportunity: to repurpose redox-active agents as FN3K inhibitors and to exploit FN3K as a biomarker for redox stratification in precision oncology. Despite promising in silico data and preclinical correlations, challenges remain - particularly in achieving target selectivity, overcoming structural limitations, and validating pharmacodynamic markers. Addressing these barriers through integrated translational strategies could unlock FN3K as a tractable node in redox-driven cancer therapy.
abstract_zh: 果糖胺-3-激酶（FN3K）是一种脱糖基化酶，最初在糖尿病背景下被研究，近期已崭露头角，成为癌症中氧化还原稳态和治疗耐药性的关键调节因子。FN3K催化早期糖化加合物的去除，从而稳定氧化还原敏感蛋白，如核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2），后者是抗氧化防御的关键转录调节因子。本综述探讨了FN3K在肿瘤代谢中不断演变的角色，重点介绍其在不同癌症类型中的表达模式、适合治疗靶向的结构特征，以及与Nrf2通路的机制性相互作用。重点评估了具有FN3K调节潜力的FDA批准药物，通过计算建模、对接模拟和构效关系见解进行分析。分析揭示了一个双重机会：将氧化还原活性药物重新定位为FN3K抑制剂，并利用FN3K作为精准肿瘤学中氧化还原分层的生物标志物。尽管有前景的计算数据和临床前相关性，挑战依然存在——特别是在实现靶点选择性、克服结构限制和验证药效动力学标志物方面。通过整合转化策略解决这些障碍，可能将FN3K解锁为氧化还原驱动癌症治疗中的一个可操作节点。
